Convergence.QiElementDef.label: metal
Convergence.QiElementDef.description: Sharp and unyielding qi. Favors swords and defense.

Convergence.QiElementDef.label: wood
Convergence.QiElementDef.description: Living, growing qi. Favors healing and spirit farming.

Convergence.QiElementDef.label: water
Convergence.QiElementDef.description: Flowing, patient qi. Favors control and endurance.

Convergence.QiElementDef.label: fire
Convergence.QiElementDef.description: Violent, consuming qi. Favors destruction and alchemy.

Convergence.QiElementDef.label: earth
Convergence.QiElementDef.description: Heavy, stable qi. Favors the body and formations.

Convergence.QiElementDef.label: thunder
Convergence.QiElementDef.description: Celestial variant qi, the punishment of heaven and its weapon. When wood feeds fire inside a root, once in a long while the flame becomes lightning. The Thunder Qilin carries it in its blood. Heavenly tribulation strikes those born of thunder more gently, as one does not burn fire with fire.
